overview: The Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities approved a letter supporting a member's appointment to the high school building committee, backed a municipal grant application for curb cuts, and discussed website resource updates along with senior outreach options.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission voted unanimously to approve the February 2024 meeting minutes.

items.title: Medford High School Building Committee Update
items.summary: Commissioner Cameron Knabb reported applying to sit on the new building committee, and the commission voted unanimously to write an official statement supporting his appointment.

items.title: ADA Municipal Improvement Grant Application
items.summary: The commission voted unanimously to support a city MOD grant application prioritizing curb cuts near the high school and other public locations.

items.title: Website Resources Review
items.summary: Commissioners reviewed proposed additions to the disability resources webpage and agreed to continue updating and restructuring the list for the next meeting.

items.title: High School Building Committee Support Statement
items.summary: Staff read the draft text supporting Commissioner Knabb's application to send to the selection and school committees.

items.title: AbleWell.org Correspondence
items.summary: The commission evaluated a request from Mary Wilson to write an article for their page and decided not to pursue or invite the author.

items.title: Senior Outreach and In-Person Meetings
items.summary: Members discussed outreach opportunities at the Medford Senior Center and potential future in-person or hybrid meetings, clarifying procedures for commissioner participation.

items.title: Commissioner Term Expirations and Recruitment
items.summary: Staff reminded commissioners up for reappointment to submit their interest by May, and members noted an applicant has expressed interest in joining the commission.

items.title: Correspondence and Announcements
items.summary: Staff shared information about the upcoming Metro Regional Disability Inclusion Summit, Community Iftar, Arab American Heritage Month events, and Prescription Drug Take Back Day.
